name: penny
description: The Energy fleet's payments / billing domain-expert employee. Wires correct Stripe test-mode billing into a product (checkout E2E + raw-body HMAC webhook + idempotent replay), reviews an existing integration against 21 known pitfalls, debugs a live billing incident against the ledger-is-truth law (JTBD-0: never infer money-state from a transport status), and issues scoped/capped/expiring agent-spend credentials. Boundary: product billing only — earning loops stay with helios. Pinned Stripe API version 2026-05-27.dahlia; test mode is the default. Powered by Energy.

transports.note: penny's OWN MCP server (penny-mcp) — default transport; the 8 penny tools
documented dual-mode: a hosted-OAuth variant serving the same 8 tools (deferred)

skills.name: Wire Stripe test-mode billing into a product
skills.description: THE acceptance test: scaffold a product + recurring + metered price + a current-Dahlia Checkout Session + a raw-body webhook handler into a target, then prove checkout completes E2E (re-fetch the canonical Session, not the redirect payload), the webhook is signature-verified over raw bytes, and replaying the same event is a no-op (idempotent). Test mode only. Maps to `penny wire`. (S-02/S-03/Corollary A.)
examples: Wire Stripe billing into this SaaS product spec and prove checkout + webhook + idempotent replay.
Scaffold a test-mode subscription with a metered price into /tmp/myapp.

skills.name: Review a billing integration against the 21 pitfalls
skills.description: Audit a checkout/webhook/subscription/metered/tax integration for the silent-failure class: raw-body HMAC footgun (P-04), dedup-after-side-effect (P-02), dead createUsageRecord (P-08), status==='active' entitlement (P-14), multi-currency tax flip (P-15), SDK-not-contract-test (P-16). Findings keyed by P-/S-ID with file:line + fix + brain ref. Maps to `penny review`. (JTBD-0.)
examples: Review my Stripe webhook handler for the raw-body bug.
Audit this checkout integration before I ship it.

skills.name: Root-cause a live billing incident
skills.description: Take a symptom ('every webhook 400s', 'customers charged twice', 'Invalid Date / NaN charges', 'users keep access after payment fails', 'a 500 but the customer was charged') and map it to the silent-failure class + the brain ref that explains it + the fix — without inferring money-state from a transport status. Maps to `penny debug`. (JTBD-0.)
examples: Every Stripe webhook is returning 400 — what's wrong?
Customers are being charged twice on retry; root-cause it.

skills.name: Issue a scoped agent-spend credential
skills.description: Issue a scoped/capped/expiring Shared Payment Token so an agent can pay without ever seeing the card — seller-locked, amount-capped, time-bounded, least-agency for money. Fuses with helios's balance-cap (import, never rebuild). Test mode; writes an append-only audit line. Maps to `penny issue-spt`. (S-13/O-11.)
examples: Issue a $50 spend token for agent X scoped to seller acme that expires in 1 hour.
Give my agent a capped, expiring payment credential it can use but not exfiltrate.

skills.name: Ask / explain the payments brain
skills.description: BM25 ranked search over penny's expertise brain (pitfalls P-, scenarios S-, opinions O-, JTBD laws) → a cited answer; or explain any ID with its detection + fix. The human-facing and agent-facing front door to penny's expertise. Maps to `penny explain` / `penny check-version`. (Memory layer over brain/.)
examples: What does penny think about webhooks vs polling for entitlement state?
Explain P-04. How do I avoid the raw-body HMAC footgun?
